gloss_en: Eretz Yisrael — the Land of Israel as a spiritual reality in Likutey Moharan: the locus and embodiment of faith (emunah), prayer, miracles, Divine providence (hashgachah) beyond nature, patience (erech apayim), and the totality of holiness; both the physical Holy Land one merits to reach and its mystical aspect (bechinat Eretz Yisrael)
